facts.fact: The document is the text of Senegal's Loi n° 2025-15 relative à l'Accès à l'Information, the country's access to information law, whose explanatory memorandum says no law fixing how the right of access is exercised existed before it; the document gives no promulgation date, so the year 2025 comes from the law's number and the document's publication date.
